rows.name: array-populate-1000
rows.source: array unset a;array set a {};for {set i 0} {$i<1000} {incr i} {set a($i) $i};array size a

rows.name: array-cursor-500
rows.source: array unset a;array set a {};for {set i 0} {$i<500} {incr i} {set a($i) $i};set s [array startsearch a];set total 0;while {[array anymore a $s]} {set k [array nextelement a $s];incr total $a($k)};array donesearch a $s;set total

rows.name: array-statistics-500
rows.source: array unset a;array set a {};for {set i 0} {$i<500} {incr i} {set a($i) $i};lindex [split [array statistics a] \n] 0

rows.name: array-retained-100
rows.source: array unset a;array set a {};proc p {} {for {set i 0} {$i<100} {incr i} {upvar #0 a($i) slot$i};array size ::a};p;lindex [split [array statistics a] \n] 0

rows.name: array-glob-500
rows.source: array unset a;array set a {};for {set i 0} {$i<500} {incr i} {set a(key$i) $i};llength [array names a *5*]

rows.name: array-mutate-200
rows.source: array unset a;array set a {};set total 0;for {set i 0} {$i<200} {incr i} {set s [array startsearch a];set a($i) $i;incr total [catch {array anymore a $s}]};set total

scope: Six small warm-session array workloads, native and Node measured separately on one host; exact results verified. Different host adapters; no full application, peak memory or cross-platform acceptance.
